description: Represents the first phase of the master's research thesis, focusing on industry problem formulation, rigorous literature review, dataset preparation, and preliminary model prototyping.
learning_objectives: Identify and formulate a high-impact applied AI or data engineering research problem.
Conduct a comprehensive literature survey analyzing state-of-the-art methodologies.
Acquire, clean, preprocess, and analyze benchmark datasets.
Develop initial mathematical formulations, baseline models, and submit the Project Phase-I dissertation report.
outline: Problem Identification & Scope: Industry problem formulation, domain analysis, research objective definition.
Literature Review: Comprehensive survey of existing state-of-the-art AI / ML methods, gaps identification, citation analysis.
Data Engineering: Dataset acquisition, validation, cleaning, exploratory data analysis, benchmark selection.
Methodology & Prototyping: Proposed architecture design, mathematical modeling, baseline implementation.
Evaluation & Reporting: Mid-semester review, preliminary experimental evaluation, Project Phase-I report compilation, and progress viva-voce presentation.

books.title: Research Design: Qualitative, Quantitative, and Mixed Methods Approaches
books.author: John W. Creswell, J. David Creswell
